assumptions: Owner-controlled sources and qualified local hosts only; immutable authorities and frozen policies; no provider permission, containment support or positive utility inferred.
compatibility: Additive opt-in offline foundations under ADR 0027; internal v0.1 records only. Existing AIM/runtime/plugin/telemetry/System 1/forecast contracts and historical evidence unchanged.
domain: Owned repository tasks, task-local guidance and selected context packaging; deterministic laboratory controls first. Arbitrary tools, scripts, hooks, policy rewrites and production source mutation are outside the initial editable surface.
execution_contract: ADR 0027 adopts only offline foundations T002–T004: immutable identity verification, bounded positive-inventory import and externally issued operator-admission reservation. No launcher or issuance API; all executionAuthorization fields false. Runner, host, context packaging, observation/export and later feature acceptance remain pending; no existing grant or runtime language is widened.
hypotheses: Contrastive refinement and scoped experience may improve both continuity and coordination at acceptable complete cost; evaluate and allow null, negative or infeasible results.
observation_contract: Candidate/source/host/policy-bound attempts, actual effects and outcomes, full denominators and costs; synthetic/native/human/economic boundaries explicit.

scope: Provide a native Agent Braid mechanism to propose, probe and compose small task-local harness variants against an immutable base, first with deterministic fixtures and later through separately qualified Codex/Claude adapters. The original historical planning assurance is preserved separately; no previous software or native acceptance is transferred.
